suivi.nom_fr: Objectif de CA ajoute par acquisitions

points.citation: We will continue over the next few years to add about EUR 250 million revenues each year from acquisition.
We think we also should add about EUR 250 million of revenues next year from acquisitions at reasonable multiple.
We do think we can achieve the EUR 250 million additional revenue in 2026, a smaller bolt-on acquisition at acceptable multiples.
On the side of those large acquisitions, we continue with our M&A, where we have a target to add about EUR 250 million revenues per year from a number of bolt-on acquisitions.
On BioPharma, our BPT is doing well. It's growing mid-single digit.
The bulk of it is our Biopharma Product Testing, where Eurofins is global leader, and that has continued to do well, mid-single digits.
The core BioPharma Product Testing, as I said, is doing well, is mid-single digit.

We continue to take opportunity of basically undervaluation, what we believe is undervaluation of our shares, to buy back within the range of our leverage commitment, which we intend to keep between 1.5 and 2.5 since we generate a lot of cash and we think we'll generate a lot more cash.
So we're confident on maintaining our leverage between the 1.5-2.5 multiple range that we have set for ourselves as an objective.
When we can buy Eurofins at 8x or 9x, or depending on what year you look at, we think it's a bargain.
Even with the recent rerating, our stock is trading at 10x.

Our EPS has shown a remarkable growth, 24%, and I think it's just the beginning, because we still have heavy, heavy investment, heavy OpEx investment, especially in our deployment of digital solutions, development of digital solutions, which should give us significant season and the cost of which will go down.
We've had a strong H1 2026 with very strong improvement of results, 29% EPS growth.
It's nice to note that our mature scope is already achieving the 24% margin we are targeting for 2027.

On slide 13, if we look at another breakdown of our H1 results between mature and non-mature scopes, we see a mature business which is reaching 25.3% margin, well ahead of our group objectives, and we see also a non-mature headwind decreasing year after year with SDI at only 0.4% of revenues.
We spent EUR 540 million to buy back our own shares.
All this enabled us to increase our share buybacks by another EUR 200 million in the first half.
Our maintenance CapEx is 2 or 3%, and with that, we can grow mid-single digit.
The overall other CapEx, which includes growth and maintenance CapEx, maintenance CapEx is 2% or 3%, and the rest is growth CapEx.
Overall, we are sticking with our objective of mid-single digit organic growth for the full year.
It is obvious that to hit mid-single-digit organic growth for this year, we need to have a significant pickup in H2.
